description: The outbound actions in an outbound whisper flow: check_outbound_call_status as a typed sub-block with no attributes, its four Equals conditions on the page's statuses in the page's order and its catch-all, with two message_participant blocks (the second carrying a position block, its layout off the default row) and end_flow_execution around it. No refs. Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
